boundary: Semantic data and actions are stable; graph layout, category colors, line styles, panels and font size remain renderer choices.

identities.records_sha256: Hash of canonical records, not native input_version
identities.input_version: Absent in static index stays Unknown; preserve ResearchBrief and native namespaces without coercion
identities.presentation_version: Visual asset version only, not scientific input or rubric version

normalized_stage1.key: JSON.stringify([work_id, version_id]); scope to project/case outside key
normalized_stage1.source_text: Preserve literal source/user text; translate interface labels only
normalized_stage1.typed_ledger_projection: not-implemented; raw search/screening is not typed discovery/decision history

similarity.formula: shared recorded methods / union recorded methods

normalized_stage1.group_counts: Distinct work/version keys with a known recorded label; overlapping topics are not disjoint coverage bins
normalized_stage1.relevance: No fabricated score; show source-bound score/rationale only if an adapter supplies its unit and identity

literature_selection.count_unit: work/version rows; not researcher formal distinct-work target
literature_selection.excluded: Retain row, reason, sources and bibliography; do not delete history
literature_selection.eligibility: Readable complete body plus checked source identity/version; individual unknown claims remain visible

normalized_stage2.paper_key: work_id/version_id in the Stage2 source packet; never join Stage1 by title

stage1_intake.source: Confirmed ResearchBrief decision history, with project/input-version/original-answer binding
stage1_intake.brief_input_version: Nonblank string or positive integer; preserve exact JSON type in every answer binding
stage1_intake.native_input_version: SessionApi registration requires 64 lowercase hex characters; not necessarily the brief's original scalar
stage1_intake.version_mapping: No implicit conversion/hash: a trusted adapter must record explicit source-bound lineage if namespaces differ; config compiler supplies none
stage1_intake.current_main_proposal: At least 30 final formally usable distinct works for new briefs
stage1_intake.historical_targets: Preserve frozen package targets; no retrospective 30 assignment
stage1_intake.selected_ui_focus: 30-40 retained papers is a viewing preference, not a research or evaluation rule

typed_ledger_extension.record_index: Backend result position; never relevance or global discovery rank
typed_ledger_extension.reversal: Append source event link; retain prior event

common.stale: Keep old value with its original input/source/rubric/judge hashes; never relabel current

stage1.aggregation: Equal-weight criterion points, frozen applicability rationale, assessed fraction and unknown bounds
stage1.legacy: Historical v1/v2 rubric IDs and denominators remain separate

stage2.formula: round(100 * sum / 6, 6) when all 3 final rows assessed
stage2.required_null: sum and score null; denominator never shrinks
stage2.audit-required: Provisional pending independent audit, even when numbers are present
stage2.candidate_checker: Separate 0-2 property checker; not the independent package dimension percentage

native.scope: Existing explicitly registered server-owned session; default disabled
native.credential: Memory only, never URL or browser storage

routes.GET /api/native/projects/{ref}/offer: Explicit durable local offer publication; zero native I/O

transcript.boundary: Observed literal item text only; item completed is not turn/research success; raw frame journal remains source

native.limit_meaning: Trusted offer may lower limits; max_starts counts API attempts, not model token/cost budget
native.idempotency: Same principal/project/key and semantic payload reads old action; changed payload rejects; refresh/lost response GET only
native.integer_boundary: Server revisions signed i64; browser rejects values outside JS safe integer range
native.transport_security: Loopback exact Host, Bearer, mandatory POST Origin, project principal allowlist and absolute request deadline

capabilities.implementation_state: Report per source/head/test boundary; pending source is not accepted main
capabilities.configured_state: Declared settings are not admitted bindings
capabilities.observed_state: Probe result, write observation, resolved request and terminal turn are separate
capabilities.maintenance: Optional bound inbox: stage1..6, UTF-8 max 4000 bytes, exact key replay, recorded-not-dispatched
capabilities.automatic_ui_repair: not-implemented; requires separate task, isolated changes, tests, PR and preview

evolution.config: Exact supported major/schema; unknown mode/authority/action field rejects
evolution.readonly_data: Preserve original fields and source paths; unknown status displays Unknown and disables actions
evolution.responses: Current wire schema stays strict; future additive readonly fields require an updated compatible schema/version before they may be ignored by the renderer
evolution.semantic_change: New version + adapter and independent validation; no silent reinterpretation
evolution.visual_change: Renderer/CSS/translation only; no score regeneration, input activation or runtime change
